g.title: #1 ParallelCapacitorsDrawnInline <ParallelCapacitorsDrawnInline firstCapacitorName="C_SD_HF" secondCapacitorName="C_SD_BULK" message="Draw C_SD_HF and C_SD_BULK beside each other as two parallel branches between their shared nets. #2 ConnectorTestPointNotAligned <ConnectorTestPointNotAligned connectorName="J_SD" testPointName="TP_SD_CLK" message="Align TP_SD_CLK with its connected terminal on J_SD, facing their pins toward each other along a straight wire.
